mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month indicates an easing monetary policy stance, which reduces discount rates for equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines over the past month, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI index above 240 signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to maintain restrictive monetary policy and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 240, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate by more than 0.1pp and an increase in non-farm payrolls by more than 100k over the past month indicates a strengthening labor market, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE declines > 0.1pp and PAYEMS increases > 100k, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle economic regime, rising residential construction permits signal robust consumer demand for housing and durable goods, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances during late-cycle expansions when HOUST increases, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index indicates expanding manufacturing output, which correlates with stronger corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO rises, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) level below 450,000 million dollars indicates weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where RSAFS < 450000, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100 indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, signaling weakening corporate earnings and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate above 5.0% indicates a weakening labor market, reducing consumer spending and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.
